origin.description: Quote each element with double quotes.
origin.details: A thin wrapper around encodeString(quote = '"', na.encode = FALSE).

translation.description: Quote each element with double quotes, using the same escapes as encodeString.
translation.details: A single quote inside the text is left as-is. A double quote and a backslash are escaped.
translation.value: A Glue vector of quoted strings.
